newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Coat Factory sets stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Coat Factory sets stock buyback.

text.p: Burlington Coat Factory Warehouse Corp said Wednesday it has adopted a stock repurchase program authorizing the president to spend up to $5 million to repurchase outstanding common.
The repurchases will be made in the open market or in negotiated transactions from time to time over the two year period starting October 11, the company said.
It said the program does not require the purchase of any minimum or maximum number of shares.
Shares repurchased will be held by the corporation as treasury stock to be used to meet the corporation's obligations under its present and future stock option plans and for other corporate purposes.
